Following 1.6.1.2:

If my library is depleted and my hand has been played down to below 7
cards, when my library becomes restocked somehow am I right in thinking
that I must wait for an instruction to draw a card before my handsize
changes?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Matt Green wrote:
>
> Following 1.6.1.2:
>
> If my library is depleted and my hand has been played down to below 7
> cards, when my library becomes restocked somehow am I right in thinking
> that I must wait for an instruction to draw a card before my handsize
> changes?

No.
You hand size doesn't change.
If you have fewer cards in your hand than your hand size, then you draw
from your library if it has any cards.
